dialogs.about: 부엌 전등이 깜박여서 아들과 전구를 갈아요

lines.en: The kitchen light flickers again. Look at it.
lines.ko: 부엌 전등이 또 깜박여요. 좀 보세요.

lines.en: I see. The bulb is very dim.
Can you change it for me?
lines.ko: 저 대신 갈아 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure, Mom. Where is the new bulb?
lines.ko: 그럼요, 어머니. 새 전구는 어디 있어요?

lines.en: In the cabinet. I bought it yesterday.
Thank you. Please turn off the switch first.
Done. Is the cord safe now?
Yes. The plug came out last night.
Oh, the room is bright again!
I am going to check the outlet later.
Hello. Do you sell light bulbs here?
Yes, Ma'am. What kind do you want?
A bright one for my kitchen ceiling.
This bulb uses less power. It isn't dim.
lines.ko: 이 전구는 전력을 덜 써요. 어둡지 않아요.

lines.en: Good. My old bulb flickered last month.
It saves electricity. It will last for years.
lines.ko: 전기를 아껴요. 몇 년은 쓸 거예요.

lines.en: I also need a small lantern.
For the yard? We have two kinds.
The yard, yes. How much are they?
Ten thousand won each. Thank you for coming, Ma'am.
lines.ko: 하나에 만 원이에요. 사모님, 와 주셔서 고마워요.
